kids.chars: ARMED is E30-D04's frame, cited here as an inset and labelled E31; this board draws no ARMED pill (§0: not drawn — the text is binding). dom.arm_toggled is annotated on this inset only; in E21 the toggle sends nothing (§11.1).

node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT book (seed 440): tick 0.10 and qty step 0.001 from the recorded instrument fixture; mark 64,012.5; 500 levels a side with seeded gaps; rows at a 10 USDT zoom; 60 trail columns of 1 s to 00:12:19 UTC; sizes, walls, prints, stops, the own orders and position, the accounts "Acct A" and "Acct B" and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic. No real account identifier, key or balance. DEMO and LIVE are separate frames, each badge read from the session environment, never the feed (C-2.11); the LIVE session holds no synthetic order, so no account appears under both; nothing on the board switches the environment.
